# jumpcloud_notification_channel (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud notification channel (email, Slack, or webhook).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Webhook notification channel
resource "jumpcloud_notification_channel" "prod_webhook" {
  name        = "Production Alerts"
  description = "Webhook for production alert notifications"
  type        = "CHANNEL_TYPE_WEBHOOK"
  enabled     = true

  configuration = jsonencode({
    webhook = {
      url             = "https://hooks.example.com/jumpcloud"
      authType        = "WEBHOOK_AUTH_TYPE_BEARER"
      authToken       = "my-secret-token"
      sslVerification = true
      customHeaders = [
        {
          key   = "X-Source"
          value = "jumpcloud"
        }
      ]
    }
  })
}

# Slack notification channel
resource "jumpcloud_notification_channel" "slack_alerts" {
  name    = "Security Slack"
  type    = "CHANNEL_TYPE_SLACK"
  enabled = true

  configuration = jsonencode({
    slack = {
      slackChannel = [
        {
          slackChannelId     = "C0123456789"
          slackTeamId        = "T0123456789"
          slackWorkspaceName = "mycompany"
        }
      ]
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String) JSON-encoded channel configuration. Structure depends on channel type (email, slack, or webhook config object).
- `name` (String) The name of the notification channel.
- `type` (String) Channel type: CHANNEL_TYPE_EMAIL, CHANNEL_TYPE_SLACK, or CHANNEL_TYPE_WEBHOOK.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the notification channel.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the notification channel is active.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the notification channel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_notification_channel.example <channel-id>
```
